messages:
Ravi (new PM): Morning team! I'm Ravi, joining product today. Quick setup Qs: how do I get on the Figma org and the canonical roadmap page? also what's the usual handoff between PM <> design for research briefs? cc @Sofia

Sofia (Design): Welcome Ravi 44b For Figma: we use SSO via Okta. Steps: Okta -> Apps -> Request 'Figma (Redwood)'. If it doesn't auto-approve ping @Kai. I'll also invite you directly to the 'Product UI Kit' file.

Kai (Design Ops): Hi Ravi 496 I checked the auto-approval rules: new hires in product auto-approve during working hours but sometimes needs manual. If you get 'pending' DM me and I'll expedite. FYI the Figma team name is "Redwood - Product".

Nina (Product): For the roadmap, go to Confluence: /product/strategy/roadmap (we keep quarterly goals + initiatives there). Also open the 'roadmap-okr' page for the split between delivery and discovery. If you want, I can share the mini readme on how we keep epics mapped to outcomes.

Ravi (new PM): thanks! on handoffs: I'm used to writing a one-paragraph problem statement + 3 success metrics. curious if design wants a full brief before discovery or a lighter "PRD-lite".

Sofia (Design): Our default is the brief template in Drive -> design/research/playbooks. Short briefs are fine for early discovery (problem + riskiest assumption + target users). For larger efforts we ask for: context, goals, known constraints, stakeholders, and a proposed timeline. We keep templates: brief.md, screener-template.md, consent-form.md.

Kai (Design Ops): Adding process note: to request a moderated study, post the brief in #design-research and add the tag "study-request". Design Ops will queue the screener creation and recruit. For guerrilla or quick hallway tests, just share a Figma prototype link and add results to the playbook.

Access Bot: Access request logged: Figma (Ravi). Ticket #ACC-8117. Estimated processing: 1-3 hours.

Ravi (new PM): I tried the Okta flow and it shows pending. Kai, I'll DM you now. Also tagging @Ninaa4 to schedule a 30-min sync about current roadmap priorities.

Nina (Product): Happy to sync. I'm free at 2:30pm PT. We can cover quick orientation: active bets, design partners, and the research cadence.

Sofia (Design): Invite sent to your email and added you to the Product UI Kit + research-playbooks. Dropped a short checklist in #product-onboarding (what to read first: roadmap overview, last quarter's research highlight, and the component inventory).

Ravi (new PM): got the invite, loading the files now. Appreciate the process notes 60a See you at 2:30pm Nina.

Kai (Design Ops): Confirmed manual approval for Figma, invite re-sent. If you still have trouble open the Access ticket and tag #devex.
